theme: An open Sunday, with the girls back home.
greeting: A rare clear Sunday, Dan — the 9 a.m. board review is behind you and the rest of the day is open. The girls are back for their stretch, and a few things have been sitting patiently in the background.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Amin on the CIFIC search
needsAttention.detail: Your Montreal recruiter followed up with the VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs mandate at CIFIC and the full JD attached, and asked whether you'd like to explore it. The thread's been open since Thursday with no reply yet.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Still open on the Mike + Dan board and marked book-this-week back in September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas sells out early — a refundable hold now removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south — last day of the window
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 gap for driving the Pathfinder Portland → St Pete ends today. If it isn't already headed down, the fallback is the monthly rental cycle you were trying to kill.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: 15-min board review — owner and date on everything

flagged.title: Odd 'document shared' email
flagged.detail: A note appearing as Fran Philip shares a generic 'Document' through an unfamiliar link (doc.ivoryhill.org) dressed up as Google — worth a careful look before opening.

flagged.title: Chainalysis role alert
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a Head of US Government Affairs opening at Chainalysis — a browse-when-you-have-a-minute, not an ask.

flagged.title: Toronto trip is confirmed
flagged.detail: The Airbnb loft (Nov 2–5) and your flights are both booked and confirmed.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions and receipts — Delta, Dermstore, Schoolhouse, an Apple receipt, and a run of booking confirmations.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply from you.

resolved.title: Suits packed for Toronto
resolved.detail: Checked off this morning ahead of the Nov 2–5 trip.

recipe.why: Autumn cooking at its best — slow, warming, and built on what the season brings in.

acts.line: A single 15-minute board review with Mike at 9 — the only fixed thing on the day.
The calendar is empty from mid-morning on; the afternoon is entirely yours.
Nothing scheduled to close the day, and the girls are back under your roof.
